UPESSC Principal Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the exam city details for the post of Principal. This recruitment was released for 111 posts. Applications for the UPESSC Principal Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 21 July 2026, to 20 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 24 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their UPESSC Principal Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 July 2026
  • Last Date : 20 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 August 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 23 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 14 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 21 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 3000/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
